title: The Policy That Worked in One Place
title_ja: 一つの場所で成功した政策
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空事例。実在の政策、医療指針、教育効果、調査結果ではない。台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Public officials searching for responses to a local problem may examine policies that appear to have achieved favorable results in other communities.
sentences.ja: 地域問題への対応を探す公務員は他地域で好ましい結果を達成したように見える政策を調べることがある。

sentences.en: Such examples can provide valuable information about possible courses of action, particularly when a community has limited experience with the problem it is attempting to address.
sentences.ja: その例は地域が対処しようとする問題の経験が限られる時、可能な行動方針について価値ある情報を提供し得る。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, evidence that a particular policy was associated with a desirable outcome in one setting does not necessarily establish that introducing a similar policy elsewhere would produce the same outcome.
sentences.ja: それでも特定政策が一環境で望ましい結果と関連したという証拠は、別の場所で同様の政策を導入すれば同結果を生むと必ずしも確定しない。

sentences.en: A policy operates through arrangements and institutions whose characteristics may differ considerably from one place to another.
sentences.ja: 政策は特徴が場所によりかなり異なる仕組みや機関を通じて働く。

sentences.en: Imagine a fictional town considering a program that allows local organizations to reserve rooms in a public facility at times when the rooms would otherwise remain unused.
sentences.ja: 通常使われない時間に地元組織が公共施設の部屋を予約できる架空町の制度を考えよう。

sentences.en: Officials learn that a neighboring town introduced a similar arrangement and subsequently reported an increase in the number of community activities taking place in its facilities.
sentences.ja: 近隣町が同様の仕組みを導入し、その後施設内の地域活動数の増加を報告したと職員は知る。

sentences.en: Some officials suggest reproducing the neighboring town's reservation process as closely as possible, believing that the reported result provides sufficient justification for the new program.
sentences.ja: 一部職員は報告結果が新制度の十分な正当化になると考え、近隣町の予約手順をできる限り忠実に再現する提案をする。

sentences.en: Others ask whether the circumstances that enabled organizations to participate in the first town are also present in their own community.
sentences.ja: 別の者は元の町で組織の参加を可能にした事情が自地域にも存在するか尋ねる。

sentences.en: The discussion begins to focus on the relationship between the reservation process and other conditions that may be necessary for its effective use.
sentences.ja: 議論は予約手順と有効利用に必要かもしれない他条件の関係に集中し始める。

sentences.en: One official points out that the first town has several established organizations that already possess the resources required to organize activities once suitable rooms become available.
sentences.ja: 最初の町には適切な部屋が利用可能になれば活動を企画するのに必要な資源を持つ確立組織が複数あるとある職員は指摘する。

sentences.en: In their own town, by contrast, some residents may be interested in organizing activities but have little experience with the administrative tasks that a reservation would require.
sentences.ja: 対照的に自町では活動企画に関心があっても予約に必要な事務作業の経験が少ない住民がいるかもしれない。

sentences.en: A program that increases the availability of meeting spaces might therefore address only one of several obstacles to participation.
sentences.ja: 会議場所の利用可能性を増やす制度は参加への複数障害の一つに対処するだけかもしれない。

sentences.en: The officials consider whether additional information or practical assistance would be relevant to the intended participants before deciding how the reservation process should be designed.
sentences.ja: 予約手順の設計を決める前に想定参加者に追加情報や実務援助が関連するか職員は考える。

sentences.en: They also acknowledge that the original report does not establish which factors caused the increase in activities in the neighboring town.
sentences.ja: 元報告が近隣町の活動増加の原因となった要因を確定しないことも認める。

sentences.en: The fictional officials consequently propose a limited trial during which they could examine what kinds of organizations use the facilities and what difficulties participants encounter.
sentences.ja: そこで架空職員はどの種類の組織が施設を使い参加者がどんな困難に遭遇するか調べられる限定試行を提案する。

sentences.en: Such a trial would not automatically establish the effectiveness of the proposed arrangement, particularly if important changes occurred elsewhere in the community during the same period.
sentences.ja: 試行は、特に同期間に地域の別の場所で重大変化が起きれば、提案仕組みの有効性を自動的に確立しない。

sentences.en: It might nevertheless provide information that could guide further investigation and help officials distinguish difficulties associated with the reservation process from difficulties arising under different circumstances.
sentences.ja: それでも追加調査を導き、予約手順に関連する困難と別事情から生じる困難を区別する助けになる情報を提供し得る。

sentences.en: Actual decisions would require appropriate evidence, community consultation and consideration of applicable requirements.
sentences.ja: 実際の判断には適切な証拠、地域の意見聴取、適用要件の考慮が必要だ。

sentences.en: Learning from another community involves more than identifying a policy that was followed by a favorable result.
sentences.ja: 他地域から学ぶには好結果が後に続いた政策の特定以上のことが伴う。

sentences.en: It requires examining the processes through which that policy might have contributed to the result and the conditions that supported those processes.
sentences.ja: 政策が結果に貢献した可能性のある過程とそれを支えた条件を調べる必要がある。

sentences.en: An adaptation that differs visibly from an original policy may preserve an important function of that policy more effectively than an arrangement that simply reproduces its outward form.
sentences.ja: 元政策と目に見えて異なる適応策は外形を単に再現する仕組みより重要な機能を効果的に保つかもしれない。

sentences.en: The value of an example lies partly in the questions it encourages officials to ask about their own community.
sentences.ja: 例の価値は職員に自地域について問わせる問いにもある。

vocabulary.definition: groups of people connected by place
act of seeking advice or views
able to apply to a situation

questions.prompt: What limitation of learning from other policies is emphasized?
options: A policy cannot provide information to another community.
Success in one setting does not prove the same policy will succeed elsewhere.
All communities have identical institutions.
A favorable outcome proves that no other factors mattered.
questions.explanation_ja: 他地域への一般化の限界。

questions.prompt: What arrangement has the neighboring town introduced?
options: Construction of private offices.
A ban on community activities.
Free transportation for every resident.
Reservations for unused public rooms.

questions.prompt: What do some officials assume about the reported increase?
options: It resulted entirely from an unrelated policy.
It demonstrates that their own town has no need for rooms.
It sufficiently justifies copying the reservation process.
It provides no information about possible action.
questions.explanation_ja: 模倣の十分な根拠と見なす。

questions.prompt: What difference between the towns is considered?
options: Existing organizational resources and administrative experience.
The total number of countries involved.
The architectural style of every room.
The language used in all newspaper articles.

questions.prompt: Why might providing rooms be insufficient?
options: Suitable rooms always prevent community participation.
Residents cannot use facilities under any circumstances.
All participants already have equal resources.
Other barriers may still prevent people from organizing activities.

questions.prompt: Why mention the limits of the original report?
options: The original report establishes every causal relationship.
An observed increase does not identify its cause by itself.
The report was never written.
No policy could contribute to an increase.

questions.prompt: What does the proposed trial examine?
options: Who uses facilities and what difficulties they encounter.
Only the appearance of the reservation form.
Whether every resident holds public office.
The exact cause of every change in the neighboring town.

questions.prompt: What could limit the trial's conclusions?
options: The fact that participants can provide information.
The existence of public rooms.
Other changes occurring in the community at the same time.
A decision to conduct further investigation.
An exact reproduction without changes.
A modification made to suit local conditions.
A record of a previous result.
An unrelated public institution.

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the argument?
options: Transferring policies requires understanding their functions and supporting conditions rather than copying their visible form.
Every policy should be copied whenever a neighboring town reports success.
Local experience always makes outside examples irrelevant.
A limited trial proves the effectiveness of all policies.
questions.explanation_ja: 機能と支援条件を理解して適応。

grammar.focus: believing that the reported result provides
grammar.explanation_ja: 分詞構文で理由・背景。

grammar.focus: more effectively than an arrangement that simply reproduces

paraphrases.source: A policy operates through arrangements and institutions whose characteristics may differ considerably from one place to another.
paraphrases.rewrite: Policies work through institutions whose features may vary across places.

paraphrases.source: Some officials suggest reproducing the neighboring town's reservation process as closely as possible, believing that the reported result provides sufficient justification for the new program.
paraphrases.rewrite: They favor copying the process because they believe the reported increase justifies it.

paraphrases.source: One official points out that the first town has several established organizations that already possess the resources required to organize activities once suitable rooms become available.
paraphrases.rewrite: Existing organizations can act when appropriate rooms are available.

paraphrases.source: An adaptation that differs visibly from an original policy may preserve an important function of that policy more effectively than an arrangement that simply reproduces its outward form.
paraphrases.rewrite: A locally modified policy may preserve the original function better than a literal copy.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 形式の模倣と機能の適応。
